name: SparkPilot
description: Connect Apple devices to DGX Spark for private chat, model management, and authenticated runtime access.
compatibility: SwiftUI iPhone/iPad clients with a Rust Spark runtime; signed model and engine recipes.
limitations: Beta testing focuses on iPhone and iPad with Nemotron Lightning; the Linux tag describes the Spark runtime.
A source build does not establish hardware qualification; not every development recipe is approved for distribution.
The Qwen engine adaptation includes separately licensed AGPL components.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
